invariants.rationale: The show method is intended to display a keyboard for a specific TextField, which suggests the textField parameter should not be null at method entry.
The method's purpose is to show a keyboard for a user-visible TextField, implying it is likely visible at the time of invocation.
It is likely that the keyboard should only be shown for an enabled TextField, so textField is probably not disabled.
A keyboard is typically shown for fields that can gain focus, suggesting at method entry that the TextField allows either focus traversal or focus.
At method entry, either no onscreen keyboard is attached or it is this keyboard instance being displayed.
